_comment: Shared marker corpus, read by internal/clarify (Go) and ui/src/Clarify.test.tsx (TS). The two parsers are deliberately duplicated (F-0175); this corpus is the lock that keeps them in step (F-0182). Every case lists ALL markers Parse/markerSpans must return, with exact raw+offset+resolved. offsets are BYTE offsets in Go and UTF-16 code-unit offsets in TS — keep marker bodies ASCII below so both agree. Cases may also carry question/options/answers: when present, both parsers must agree on the marker's parsed question, options and answer trail (F-0282, criterion 4) — that is where the escaped-pipe form is locked.

_resolve_comment: Resolution parity (F-0193): each case rewrites ONE anchored open marker to its resolved form. Go replays via clarify.Resolve + manual splice (TestResolveCorpus); TS replays via resolveMarker (Clarify.test.tsx). want=null means the rewriter must refuse (anchor mismatch or already resolved).

_correct_comment: Correction parity (F-0197): each case rewrites ONE anchored RESOLVED marker, appending the new answer to its trail instead of replacing it. Go replays via clarify.Correct + manual splice (TestCorrectCorpus); TS replays via correctMarker (Clarify.test.tsx). want=null means the rewriter must refuse (anchor mismatch, or a still-open marker — correcting an open marker is answering it). Anchor offsets stay BEFORE any arrow: the arrow is 3 bytes in Go and 1 code unit in TS, so a later offset would not agree on both sides.
